Know the Signs of Poor Indoor Air Quality

Air pollution is a surprisingly common problem in houses and other indoor spaces, but it's rarely visible to the human eye. Unfortunately, this often allows it to go unnoticed — until it begins affecting your health. The most common complaints include headache, dizziness, nausea, fatigue, and irritation of the eyes, nose, and throat. These symptoms usually only appear when you're home and quickly resolve whenever you leave. Over time, however, chronic exposure to poor IAQ can lead to more serious long-term health conditions. Other red flags to look out for include:

  • Foul, persistent odors with no obvious source
  • Excessive dust in the air and on surfaces
  • Worsening allergies or more frequent asthma attacks

Better IAQ Starts with Effective Filtration

Not only are many airborne pollutants too small to see, but they're also too small for ordinary air filters to capture. Standard HVAC filters are primarily designed to trap dust and dander that may otherwise accumulate inside your system. Filters with higher MERV ratings can remove smaller particles more effectively but may also impact performance by restricting airflow.

For truly robust filtration, consider adding a high-efficiency air cleaner or air purifier to your HVAC system. These add-ons use advanced technologies like activated carbon, electrostatic air filters, and ultraviolet lights to reduce harmful particles by up to 99%. Products like the Lennox PureAir Air Purification System can even neutralize airborne pathogens, helping to prevent the spread of illnesses.

An All-Inclusive Approach to a Healthy Home

From dander, pollen, and dust mites to volatile organic compounds (VOCs), many different contaminants can impact indoor air quality. Even excessively high or low humidity can be problematic. Consequently, there's no such thing as a one-size-fits-all IAQ solution. Instead, it requires a strategy tailored to your specific needs and preferences.

At G.C. Reliable Service, that's precisely what we provide. Our specialists work with you to ensure you get the solutions you need — and nothing that you don't. In addition to high-performance filtration systems, we offer a full array of air-quality products from Daikin and Lennox. This includes whole-home ventilators, humidifiers, dehumidifiers, smart IAQ monitors, germicidal UV lights, and more.

If you have concerns about your IAQ, don't let airborne pollutants compromise your health and peace of mind. Let the experts at G.C. Reliable Service create a customized indoor air quality treatment plan for your home.
